staticLabel: LabelRule__mdt row=[SELECT MasterLabel,DeveloperName FROM LabelRule__mdt WHERE DeveloperName='Alpha']; return new Map<String,Object>{'label'=>row.MasterLabel,'name'=>row.DeveloperName};
dynamicLabel: SObject row=Database.query('SELECT MasterLabel FROM LabelRule__mdt WHERE MasterLabel = \'Visible Alpha\' LIMIT 1'); return new Map<String,Object>{'label'=>row.get('MasterLabel')};
emptyLabel: List<LabelRule__mdt> rows=[SELECT MasterLabel FROM LabelRule__mdt WHERE DeveloperName='Absent']; return new Map<String,Object>{'count'=>rows.size()};
invalidField: try { Database.query('SELECT MissingField FROM LabelRule__mdt'); return new Map<String,Object>{'rejected'=>false}; } catch(QueryException e) {return new Map<String,Object>{'rejected'=>true};}
